operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to enter the European market in 2025.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning. How is the European expansion planning coming along?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It has shifted a bit. Earlier, I planned to enter the European market in 2025.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I now plan to enter the European market in 2026, paired with a German distribution partnership.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a more deliberate launch structure. Is the financial planning aligned?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The CFO is finalizing the European P&L now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Once that is ready, it should make the board communication much cleaner.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I would rather present a fully grounded 2026 plan than force the earlier 2025 timeline.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier plan to enter Europe in 2025; retain the current 2026 plan and the rest of the details.
